uiClickAutoInstallToStartCheckingAndInst: Click Auto install to start checking and installing local tools.
uiCommandRunByNpmRunDevForExample: Command run by npm run dev, for example C:/Applio/run-applio.bat.
uiCommandUsedByNpmRunDevWhenProvider: Command used by npm run dev when provider is enabled. Example: C:/TOOLS/GPT-SoVITS/go-api.bat
uiFirstRunMayDownloadLoadModelsSoKeep: First run may download/load models, so keep this high.
uiGetEndpointUsedByHealthCheck: GET endpoint used by health check.
uiInstallTheMissingToolsThenClickCheckTo: Install the missing tools, then click Check tools again.
uiNoSetupTaskHasRunYet: No setup task has run yet.
uiTheAppRunsEachRequiredCommandOneBy: The app runs each required command one by one and keeps going even if one task fails.
